title: ToKi Atlas Definition
description: A sprite atlas definition containing tile definitions and metadata for the ToKi game engine

image.description: Filename of the associated image file (PNG, JPG, etc.)

tile_size.description: Size of each tile [width, height] in pixels

color_mode.description: How the atlas image should be interpreted during rendering

palette.description: Default palette id for palette-indexed atlases

palette_size.description: Expected palette size for palette-indexed atlases. Defaults to 4 when absent.

tiles.description: Dictionary of tiles keyed by tile name

auto_tile_groups.description: Named auto-tile groups mapping bitmask indices to tile variants

animated_tiles.description: Named animated tile definitions with frame sequences

position.description: Position of tile in atlas grid [column, row] (0-indexed)

trigger.description: Whether this tile acts as a trigger zone

mode.description: Bitmask mode: four_bit (16 variants, cardinal) or eight_bit (47 Wang tile variants)

preview_tile.description: Tile name shown in brush selector and used as fallback for missing variants

variants.description: Bitmask index (as string) to tile name mapping

frames.description: Ordered list of tile names forming the animation frames

frame_duration_ms.description: Default duration per frame in milliseconds
